newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Yemen, Amoco in production sharing MoU - MEES.
newsitem.headline: Yemen, Amoco in production sharing MoU - MEES.

text.p: Yemen and Amoco Corp of the United States have signed a memorandum of understanding for a production-sharing agreement in the Shabwa block, the Middle East Economic Survey (MEES) reported on Monday.

"MEES learns that the Yemeni Ministry of Petroleum and Minerals has signed a memorandum of understanding with Amoco of the U.S. for a production sharing agreement covering Shabwa Block No. S-1," the newsletter said. It gave no details.
MEES said the block was relinquished by Pecten Shell in 1994 after the drilling of four wells which Shell described as disappointing.
